groups.root_cause: Eval resume rejects the whole request when the saved state mentions a retired model, when it should drop or skip that model and keep going with the supported targets and fallbacks.
Loading persisted operator routing overrides at startup fails hard on retired IDs instead of filtering them out, so the daemon cannot start.
Parsing the SSH destination in local management does not handle bare IPv6 addresses, so it throws before SSH is ever contacted.
The configured provider is found by matching the SSH destination string against the provider's HTTP origin, which fails when an alias and an IP refer to the same host.
The anchor in the OPERATIONS.md link to the GUIDE's LAN provider example points to the wrong section.
OPERATIONS.md still gives the old llama-server binary location, which no longer matches the generated unit's new default path.
